title: Smart Data Models - CF Metadata Conventions - GridMapping
description: A grid mapping variable of a CF-netCDF dataset: a container for the attributes that define the coordinate reference system / map projection of the data (CF Metadata Conventions 1.13, Section 5.6 and Appendix F). Attribute names are kept verbatim except 'source' -> 'cfSource' and 'location' -> 'cfLocation'.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GridMapping'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

variableName.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#_naming_conventions'. Name of the netCDF variable in the dataset (the name that CF attributes such as coordinates, bounds, grid_mapping or ancillary_variables refer to). Smart Data Models addition: in netCDF this is the variable's name, not an attribute.

refDataset.description: Relationship. Reference to the Dataset (netCDF file) that contains this variable. Smart Data Models addition (in CF the variable is part of the file).

azimuth_of_central_line.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/azimuth_of_central_line'. Specifies a horizontal angle measured in degrees clockwise from North. Used by certain projections (e.g., Oblique Mercator) to define the orientation of the map projection relative to a reference direction. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

crs_wkt.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/crs_wkt'. This optional attribute may be used to specify multiple coordinate system properties in well-known text (WKT) format. The syntax must conform to the WKT format as specified in reference [OGC_WKT-CRS]. Use of the crs_wkt attribute is described in section 5.6.1. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

earth_radius.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/earth_radius'. Used to specify the radius, in metres, of the spherical figure used to approximate the shape of the Earth. This attribute should be specified for those projected coordinate reference systems in which the X-Y cartesian coordinates have been derived using a spherical Earth approximation. If the cartesian coordinates were derived using an ellipsoid, this attribute should not be defined. Example: "6371007", which is the radius of the GRS 1980 Authalic Sphere. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

false_easting.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/false_easting'. Applied to all abscissa values in the rectangular coordinates for a map projection in order to eliminate negative numbers. Expressed in the unit of the coordinate variable identified by the standard name projection_x_coordinate. If false_easting is not provided it is assumed to be 0. The formula to convert from the coordinate value as written in the projection_x_coordinate (xf) to a value (x0) used in a transformation without false_easting, i.e. false_easting= 0, is: x0 = xf -false_easting (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

false_northing.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/false_northing'. Applied to all ordinate values in the rectangular coordinates for a map projection in order to eliminate negative numbers. Expressed in the unit of the coordinate variable identified by the standard name projection_y_coordinate. If false_northing is not provided it is assumed to be 0. The formula to convert from the coordinate value as written in the projection_y_coordinate (yf) to a value (y0) used in a transformation without false_northing, i.e. false_northing= 0, is: y0 = yf -false_northing (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

fixed_angle_axis.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/fixed_angle_axis'. Indicates the axis on which the view is fixed in a hypothetical gimbal view model of the Earth, as used in the geostationary grid mapping. It corresponds to the inner-gimbal axis of the gimbal view model, whose axis of rotation moves about the outer-gimbal axis. This value can adopt two values, "x" or "y", corresponding with the Earth’s E-W or N-S axis, respectively. The counterpart to this attribute is sweep_angle_axis. If set to "x", sweep_angle_axis is "y", and vice versa. If one of the attributes fixed_angle_axis or sweep_angle_axis is provided, the other is not mandatory, as they can be used to infer each other. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

geographic_crs_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/geographic_crs_name'. The name of the geographic coordinate reference system. Corresponds to a OGC WKT GEOGCS node name. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

geoid_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/geoid_name'. The name of the estimate or model of the geoid being used as a datum, e.g. GEOID12B. Corresponds to an OGC WKT VERT_DATUM name. The geoid is the surface of constant geopotential that the ocean would follow if it were at rest. This attribute and geopotential_datum_name cannot both be specified. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

geopotential_datum_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/geopotential_datum_name'. The name of an estimated surface of constant geopotential being used as a datum, e.g. NAVD88. Such a surface is often called an equipotential surface in geodesy. Corresponds to an OGC WKT VERT_DATUM name. This attribute and geoid_name cannot both be specified. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

grid_mapping_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/grid_mapping_name'. The name used to identify the grid mapping. The 17 grid mappings of Appendix F. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

grid_north_pole_latitude.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/grid_north_pole_latitude'. True latitude (degrees_north) of the north pole of the rotated grid. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

grid_north_pole_longitude.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/grid_north_pole_longitude'. True longitude (degrees_east) of the north pole of the rotated grid. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

horizontal_datum_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/horizontal_datum_name'. The name of the geodetic (horizontal) datum, which corresponds to the procedure used to measure positions on the surface of the Earth. Valid datum names and their associated parameters are given in horiz_datum.csv (OGC_DATUM_NAME column), following Table 2 in [CF-WKT]. The valid names are obtained by transforming the EPSG name using the following rules (used by OGR and Cadcorp): convert all non alphanumeric characters (including +) to underscores, then strip any leading, trailing or repeating underscores. This is to ensure that named datums can be correctly identified for precise datum transformations (see [CF-WKT] for more details). Corresponds to a OGC WKT DATUM node name. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

indexing_scheme.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/indexing_scheme'. The HEALPix cell indexing scheme, either nested, ring, nuniq, or zuniq. See HEALPix for more detailed definitions. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

inverse_flattening.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/inverse_flattening'. Used to specify the inverse flattening (1/f) of the ellipsoidal figure associated with the geodetic datum and used to approximate the shape of the Earth. The flattening (f) of the ellipsoid is related to the semi-major and semi-minor axes by the formula f = (a-b)/a. In the case of a spherical Earth this attribute should be omitted or set to zero. Example: 298.257222101 for the GRS 1980 ellipsoid. (Note: By convention the dimensions of an ellipsoid are specified using either the semi-major and semi-minor axis lengths, or the semi-major axis length and the inverse flattening. If all three attributes are specified then the supplied values must be consistent with the aforementioned formula.) (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

latitude_of_projection_origin.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/latitude_of_projection_origin'. The latitude (degrees_north) chosen as the origin of rectangular coordinates for a map projection. Domain: -90.0 <= latitude_of_projection_origin <= 90.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

refinement_level.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/refinement_level'. The refinement level of the grid within the HEALPix hierarchy, starting at 0 for the base tessellation with 12 cells globally, 1 for the next level with 48 cells globally, etc. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

longitude_of_central_meridian.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/longitude_of_central_meridian'. The line of longitude (degrees_east) at the center of a map projection generally used as the basis for constructing the projection. Domain: -180.0 <= longitude_of_central_meridian < 180.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

longitude_of_prime_meridian.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/longitude_of_prime_meridian'. Specifies the longitude, with respect to Greenwich, of the prime meridian associated with the geodetic datum. The prime meridian defines the origin from which longitude values are determined. Not to be confused with the projection origin longitude (cf. longitude_of_projection_origin, a.k.a. central meridian) which defines the longitude of the map projection origin. Domain: + -180.0 <= longitude_of_prime_meridian < 180.0 decimal degrees. Default = 0.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

longitude_of_projection_origin.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/longitude_of_projection_origin'. The longitude (degrees_east) chosen as the origin of rectangular coordinates for a map projection. Domain: + -180.0 <= longitude_of_projection_origin < 180.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

north_pole_grid_longitude.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/north_pole_grid_longitude'. Longitude (degrees) of the true north pole in the rotated grid. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

perspective_point_height.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/perspective_point_height'. Records the height, in metres, of the map projection perspective point above the ellipsoid (or sphere). Used by perspective-type map projections, for example the Vertical Perspective Projection, which may be used to simulate the view from a Meteosat satellite. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

prime_meridian_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/prime_meridian_name'. The name of the prime meridian associated with the geodetic datum. Valid names are given in prime_meridian.csv, following Table 2 in [CF-WKT]. Corresponds to a OGC WKT PRIMEM node name. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

projected_crs_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/projected_crs_name'. The name of the projected coordinate reference system. Corresponds to a OGC WKT PROJCS node name. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

reference_ellipsoid_name.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/reference_ellipsoid_name'. The name of the reference ellipsoid. Valid names are given in ellipsoid.csv, following Table 2 in [CF-WKT]. Corresponds to a OGC WKT SPHEROID node name. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

scale_factor_at_central_meridian.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/scale_factor_at_central_meridian'. A multiplier for reducing a distance obtained from a map by computation or scaling to the actual distance along the central meridian. Domain: scale_factor_at_central_meridian > 0.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

scale_factor_at_projection_origin.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/scale_factor_at_projection_origin'. A multiplier for reducing a distance obtained from a map by computation or scaling to the actual distance at the projection origin. Domain: scale_factor_at_projection_origin > 0.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

semi_major_axis.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/semi_major_axis'. Specifies the length, in metres, of the semi-major axis of the ellipsoidal figure associated with the geodetic datum and used to approximate the shape of the Earth. Commonly denoted using the symbol a. In the case of a spherical Earth approximation this attribute defines the radius of the Earth. See also the inverse_flattening attribute. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

semi_minor_axis.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/semi_minor_axis'. Specifies the length, in metres, of the semi-minor axis of the ellipsoidal figure associated with the geodetic datum and used to approximate the shape of the Earth. Commonly denoted using the symbol b. In the case of a spherical Earth approximation this attribute should be omitted (the preferred option) or else set equal to the value of the semi_major_axis attribute. See also the inverse_flattening attribute. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

standard_parallel.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/standard_parallel'. Specifies the line, or lines, of latitude at which the developable map projection surface (plane, cone, or cylinder) touches the reference sphere or ellipsoid used to represent the Earth. Since there is zero scale distortion along a standard parallel it is also referred to as a "latitude of true scale". In the situation where a conical developable surface intersects the reference ellipsoid there are two standard parallels, in which case this attribute can be used as a vector to record both latitude values, with the additional convention that the standard parallel nearest the pole (N or S) is provided first. Domain: -90.0 <= standard_parallel <= 90.0 (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)

sweep_angle_axis.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/sweep_angle_axis'. Indicates the axis on which the view sweeps in a hypothetical gimbal view model of the Earth, as used in the geostationary grid mapping. It corresponds to the outer-gimbal axis of the gimbal view model, about whose axis of rotation the gimbal-gimbal axis moves. This value can adopt two values, "x" or "y", corresponding with the Earth’s E-W or N-S axis, respectively. The counterpart to this attribute is fixed_angle_axis. If set to "x", fixed_angle_axis is "y", and vice versa. If one of the attributes fixed_angle_axis or sweep_angle_axis is provided, the other is not mandatory, as they can be used to infer each other. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type string.)

towgs84.description: Property. Model:'https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html#appendix-grid-mappings/towgs84'. This indicates a list of up to 7 Bursa Wolf transformation parameters., which can be used to approximate a transformation from the horizontal datum to the WGS84 datum. More precise datum transformations can be done with datum shift grids. Represented as a double-precision array, with 3, 6 or 7 values (if there are less than 7 values the remaining are considered to be zero). Corresponds to a OGC WKT TOWGS84 node. (CF 1.13 Appendix F, Table F.1: type numeric.)
